title: The Rescuers
blurb: An earnest, none-too-graceful albatross who serves as air transport for the Rescue Aid Society mice in The Rescuers.
facts: Both must free a young orphan Penny from two treasure hunters, who intend to use her to help them obtain a giant diamond.
The film is based on a series of books by Margery Sharp, including The Rescuers (1959) and Miss Bianca (1962).
